t: Tosier Chocolatemaker
s: Tosier Chocolatemaker is an independent family business based on the Suffolk coast, creating award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate made from fully traceable single origin cocoa beans. Our chocolate is vegan, as well as gluten, dairy and additive free. We fine flavoured beans with a direct trade model that ensures sustainability and positive outcomes for the small holder farmers and cooperatives we buy from.
